correctness.rationale: Reconstructed identities B_n=P_{2n}/2, C_n=Q_{2n} and X_n=8Y_n+k. Exact Pell telescoping gives X_{n+1}-X_n=2P_{2k}P_{2k+4n+4}, Y difference=(P_{2k}/4)P_{2k+4n+4}. For even k, strong divisibility gives gcd_{n>=0}P_{2k+4n+4}=P_4=12, hence increment gcds 48B_k and 6B_k. First-window identities reduce the infinite gcd to gcd(X_0,48B_k) and gcd(Y_0,6B_k). At 3, nu_3(B_k)=1+nu_3(k); at 2, u=B_k/k≡3 (mod 16), C_k≡1 (mod 16), leading to nu2(X0)=nu2(k), nu2(Y0)=nu2(k)-1; odd p valuations from first-window congruences. Therefore gcd X=gcd(k,B_k), gcd Y=gcd(k,B_k)/2 for all even k>0. Independently computed windows for k=2..22 and many starting n, matching both formulas; infinite proof is symbolic.
